question_text: Survey Segment (Gen Pop / Fine Jewelry Buyer)
recode_hint: CONTEXT: This is a core classification variable derived from multiple screening criteria for quotas. Gen Pop (Short Complete) is defined by: B01≠3 (did not select Fine Jewelry in B01) OR B12 < $1,500 (most expensive piece is less than $1,500). Fine Jewelry Buyer (Long Complete) is defined by: B01=3 (selected Fine Jewelry in B01) AND B03_3 ≥ $500 (spent $500+ on a single item in B03) AND B05 ≠ 2 (owns fine jewelry items in B05) AND B12 ≥ $1,500 (most expensive piece is $1,500+). These segments also incorporate age (18-77) and HHI ($150,000 or more for Gen Pop target) criteria from page 1.
